schedule_semantics.conformity_and_completeness: Each instrument carries two controls. The conformity control is statutory and tests that nothing the policy states about the instrument conflicts with the statute. The completeness control is advisory and tests whether the policy restates the statutory conditions. The split exists because Sec. 2256.005(b)(4)(A) requires a list of types, not a restatement of each type's conditions, and Sec. 2256.024 makes those conditions bind whether or not the policy repeats them.
